title: Passive realism in the presence of open system dynamics
summary: We introduce the terminology \emph{passive realism} to encapsulate the scale-independent assumption that a physical system's pre-existing properties can be passively observed without altering its subsequent dynamics. A necessary condition for passive realism is provided by the no-signalling in time (NSIT) condition, which states that a measurement outcome is independent of whether or not a prior measurement was performed.
